name: Rutgers Upward Bound Math-Science (RUBMS)
what_you_do: Free college prep all year. You get SAT/ACT prep, tutoring, college tours and STEM workshops. A six-week Summer Institute on campus is required. It has college-level classes.
who_can_apply: Students who finished 8th grade and are in 9th, 10th or 11th grade. You must live in and go to school in New Brunswick, Perth Amboy or Plainfield. You must be first in your family to go to college, or low income. You must be a US citizen or permanent resident. You need at least a C average and a plan to go to college. You must send an application and a personal statement, and do an interview.
pay_detail: Free program. The page read does not say if students get paid.
duration: Year-round, with a six-week Summer Institute
deadline_text: The page says online applications open in mid-September and close in mid-December each year. A 2027 application link is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Upward Bound Math-Science 2027 Application link on the page. Questions: upwardbound@echo.rutgers.edu or (848) 445-3090. Virtual open houses are held in fall in English and Spanish.
notes: Students must be willing to get to campus every day of the summer (parent ride or bus program). A separate Pre-College Outreach program is described on the same page.
